title: Kamailio On ClueCon Weekly – June 4, 2021
html:
The ClueCon Weekly on the 4th of June 2021, at 10:00am CT, will host Daniel-Constantin Mierla for a live chat about latest Kamailio 5.5 series: what are the changes compared with the previous version, the new features as well as what to expect in the future.

Anyone can participate in the live video conference, more details are available at:

  • https://www.cluecon.com/cclive-6-4/

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
